papers.title_en: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
papers.authors: Jing Wei, Guanyi Chen, Qi Chen, Chuyu Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Chutian Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.evidence: 具备负载感知调度的用户态 GPU 存储栈
papers.tldr: 数据密集型GPU应用以NVMe扩展显存，但现有GDS逐请求经过内核、流式接口强制全序且实现封闭，限制小I/O效率与可调试性。uGDS将NVMe命令生命周期移至用户态，数据仍经PCIe点对点DMA直达GPU，并以队列分区和工作负载感知调度支持同步、批量及流式访问。A100测试中，其批量读写带宽最高为GDS的12.12倍和30.69倍，4KB同步写延迟降低84.1%。该开源方案还兼容CUDA/HIP，为跨厂商GPU存储栈提供透明、可定制的高性能路径。
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive GPU applications increasingly rely on NVMe SSDs to extend GPU memory. NVIDIA GPU Direct Storage (GDS) enables direct SSD-GPU transfers via PCIe peer-to-peer DMA, eliminating host staging. However, GDS retains three key limitations: (1) its control path traverses the kernel for every I/O request, introducing software overhead; (2) its stream-ordered path imposes strict total ordering even when workloads only require batch-level ordering; and (3) its closed-source user-space engine hinders diagnosis and custom scheduling.   We present uGDS, https://github.com/ScaleX-IO/uGDS, an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library built on four principles: user-space control, unified cross-vendor abstraction, workload-aware scheduling, and end-to-end transparency. The host CPU manages the entire NVMe command lifecycle in user space, while payloads move via PCIe P2P DMA without consuming GPU compute. A minimal kernel module (ugds_drv.ko) is used only for one-time privileged setup. uGDS partitions hardware queues between synchronous and batch traffic, enforces DMA-safe buffer lifetimes, and provides cuFile-compatible synchronous, batched, and stream-ordered APIs with polling or interrupt completion on both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP.   Evaluated on an A100 with a Samsung 990 PRO, uGDS achieves up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth and 30.69x its batch-write bandwidth (8- and 4-KiB requests, batch size 128), and reduces 4-KiB synchronous write latency by 84.1% with two threads. Its stream-ordered path sustains 5.49 GiB/s on a single stream, where GDS retains only 40.8% of its synchronous bandwidth. In LMCache, uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7% and raises serving goodput by 2.63x. On AMD, uGDS achieves up to 1.19x hipFile's synchronous-write bandwidth.

papers.title_en: VS-Flash: Harnessing Vector Search with Computational Memory-Semantic Flash
papers.authors: Donguk Kim, Sangjun Pae, Daeyoung Lee, Dong Kim
papers.evidence: 面向可扩展RAG服务的闪存向量检索基础设施
papers.tldr: RAG推动向量数据库规模超出主机DRAM后，基于MMap和SSD的高扇出ANN检索会争抢内存与存储资源，导致批量吞吐下降、混合负载尾延迟恶化。VS-Flash将闪存暴露为内存语义容量空间，并按查询批量和运行时负载动态分配计算位置。大批量查询卸载至CMS-Flash，小批量时延敏感请求保留在主机CPU，二者共享驻留数据段而无需DRAM副本。在三个十亿级数据集上，其平均批量吞吐提升36.8倍，混合负载下小请求p99延迟最高降低24.8倍，证明了超越DRAM容量的可扩展高效向量检索路径。
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI continues to evolve, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are driving rapid growth in vector database capacity requirements. As datasets outgrow host DRAM, vector databases rely on MMap-based serving over SSDs to extend capacity. However, high-fan-out ANN searches generate concurrent irregular accesses that contend for host memory and storage resources, degrading bulk throughput and inflating tail latency under mixed workloads. In this paper, we address these challenges through memory-semantic capacity and workload-aware compute placement. VS-Flash exposes flash as a large-capacity memory-semantic space and dynamically selects the execution engine according to runtime query and workload characteristics. It offloads throughput-oriented large-batch queries to a Computational Memory-Semantic Flash (CMS-Flash) device, while executing latency-sensitive small-batch queries on the host CPU. Both paths access the same resident segments, avoiding a separate host-DRAM replica. Across three billion-scale datasets, VS-Flash improves bulk-search throughput over vanilla Milvus by 36.8X on average, with up to a 57.4X improvement. Under mixed workloads, VS-Flash reduces the p99 latency of latency-sensitive requests by up to 24.8X while sustaining device-side bulk search. These results show that VS-Flash delivers scalable vector search beyond host DRAM capacity while jointly improving bulk throughput and small-request tail latency.

papers.title_en: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
papers.authors: Deng Pan, Xue-Jian Gao, Junyi Fan, Bin Du, Jiasheng Li, Xinxian Chen, Nok Yan Chang, Xinlin Li, Lingchao Zheng, Jun Li, Yuwei Fan
papers.evidence: 面向深度学习负载的高性能 NPU 算子自动生成
papers.tldr: 昇腾NPU高性能自定义算子开发依赖专家，现有智能体受限于AscendC训练数据稀缺，难以稳定生成可部署内核。CAKE面向CANN构建，采用自适应多DSL路由，并区分生成与进化模式，结合经审阅知识库和自进化智能体复用经验。在53个CANN-Bench算子上，标准集全部通过、隐藏集通过率98.28%，平均得分78.63、较基线加速1.334倍。进一步进化可显著减少设备时间与屋顶线差距，为缩小昇腾AI内核开发能力差距提供实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.

papers.title_en: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
papers.authors: Ali Sarabadani, Massimo Piccardi, Mehran Abolhasan, Farzad Tofigh, Ian Zhou, Justin Lipman
papers.evidence: 面向多模态模型的高效联邦学习
papers.tldr: 联邦学习虽能保护分散数据隐私，但面向自然语言和图像等多模态任务时，模型训练与传输的计算、内存和通信开销较高。FederatedBytes将文本和图像统一视为字节序列，采用轻量线性注意力构建无分词器小语言模型。在多语种情感分析及ScienceQA多模态评测中，其准确率超过ByT5和LSTM，并显著降低内存与通信负担。该设计为资源受限客户端上的高效隐私多模态联邦学习提供了通用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. The experimental results show that FederatedBytes has been able to outperform comparable models such as ByT5 and LSTM, achieving higher accuracy while significantly reducing memory and communication overheads.

papers.title_en: JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment
papers.authors: Quentin Delfosse, Raban Emunds, Paul Seitz, Sebastian Wette, Jannis Blüml, Daniel Kirn, Dominik Mandok, Kristian Kersting
papers.evidence: GPU并行环境消除训练流水线瓶颈
papers.tldr: Arcade Learning Environment长期是深度强化学习标准基准，但缺少原生对象提取与环境修改能力，且依赖CPU仿真，制约因果鲁棒性研究和GPU训练吞吐。JAXtari以开源方式重实现Atari 2600环境，并利用JAX/GPU大规模并行，同时提供对象中心观测和灵活修改机制。单张A100上，PPO完成1亿环境步训练不足一小时；部分发现、训练与适应流程可缩短至数分钟。该系统兼顾高吞吐、可控干预与易改造性，为研究神经符号方法、视觉捷径及鲁棒因果策略提供基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.

papers.title_en: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
papers.authors: Jiang Wu, Yutong Song, Hongbo Wang, Guanghe Cao, Jeff Liang
papers.evidence: 面向推荐的大模型高效服务运行时
papers.tldr: 语言模型可利用物品文本、用户历史与反馈进行个性化推荐，但逐候选输入完整文本导致在线计算昂贵、吞吐受限。DuoLM将离线物品编码器与在线个性化排序器结合，并以端到端推荐监督和教师蒸馏训练。运行时通过虚拟词元标识、历史计算共享和CUDA Graph回放加速推理。实验显示其质量接近专家教师模型，单张H100每秒可评分约26400个候选，吞吐约为教师模型的60倍。
papers.abstract_en: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.

papers.title_en: Superposed analog memory for vector storage in neural networks
papers.authors: Athanasios Vasilopoulos, Patrick Diener, Michael Hersche, Abbas Rahimi, Abu Sebastian
papers.evidence: 面向神经网络向量存储的模拟内存架构
papers.tldr: 神经网络中的权重与嵌入向量规模持续膨胀，传统存储需为每个高维向量分配大量单元，制约密度和能效。论文提出模拟叠加存储，在同一存储阵列中以分布式叠加编码多个向量，并通过存内矩阵—向量乘法恢复目标向量。相变存储芯片实验表明，在推荐模型和大语言模型嵌入表上可获得接近全精度软件基线的推理准确率，同时能以可调保真度换取更高有效存储密度，并具备器件噪声鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: The growing memory demands of artificial neural networks pose a major challenge for energy-efficient computing, particularly for models that rely on large collections of high-dimensional weight and embedding vectors. Conventional memory architectures store these vectors individually, requiring many memory cells per vector and limiting achievable storage density. Here we demonstrate an analog memory architecture that encodes multiple vectors in a distributed superposition within a single memory array. Individual vectors are recovered through in-memory matrix-vector multiplication, allowing the degree of superposition to be tuned to balance storage density against recall fidelity. This approach introduces a new scaling dimension for analog memory, in which effective storage density can be increased without a corresponding increase in the number of physical memory cells. The distributed representation also provides resilience to device-level noise. We implement the architecture on a prototype phase-change memory chip and experimentally evaluate it using embedding tables from deep learning recommendation models and large language models. The results demonstrate inference accuracy comparable to full-precision software baselines, establishing analog superposition as a promising route towards dense, energy-efficient memory for artificial intelligence.

papers.title_en: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
papers.authors: Jinyang Li, Denis Emelin, Simone Tedeschi, Weiwei Cheng, Cristina Morariu, Haytham Assem, Jens Lehmann, Emine Yilmaz, Angus Addlesee
papers.evidence: 面向可扩展 AI 服务的时延感知大模型路由基准
papers.tldr: 面向大规模对话式生成式人工智能，现有大模型路由评测普遍假设可获得所有候选模型结果，且未将响应延迟作为核心目标。RouterWorld整合37.1万单轮回答与7.6万多轮智能体轨迹，以统一裁判协议和硬件级延迟标注评估路由。它提出冷启动与Voyager两种部分可观测设定，模拟稀疏日志和持续数据流。13个基线的结果显示，多数路由器偏重准确性、忽视延迟，为更贴近真实部署的路由研究提供基准。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.

papers.title_en: From Last-Layer to Cross-Layer: One-Shot Joint Classifier Reconstruction for Federated Learning
papers.authors: Zhenyan Liu, Hua Zhang, Haoran Gao, Huiyu Zhou, Zongliang Shen, Qi Li, Hongliang Zhu, Yongji Wang, Zian Tian
papers.evidence: 面向联邦学习的跨层分类器重建
papers.tldr: 联邦学习中的非独立同分布数据会造成分类器偏置，而仅重构末层分类器受限于全局模型末层表征质量。FLARE利用多个中间层与末层的类别条件统计，在服务器端联合构建跨层岭回归分类器，并以自适应耦合系数建模层间关联。该方法训练后仅需一次额外通信轮和客户端单次前向传播，平均提升准确率11.35%。它突破了单层重构范式，为无辅助数据的联邦后处理提供了即插即用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training while preserving data privacy. However, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data inevitably introduces classifier bias, leading to significant performance degradation. Existing studies primarily focus on calibrating or reconstructing the classifier after FL training to alleviate this bias. We find that the last-layer representations of the global model are often suboptimal for establishing a global decision boundary. Instead, classifiers constructed based on intermediate-layer representations can achieve superior performance. This finding provides a critical insight into overcoming the performance bottleneck inherent in existing paradigms. Nevertheless, identifying the optimal layer without auxiliary datasets or prior knowledge remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we propose FLARE (Federated Cross-Layer Joint ClAssifier REconstruction) which rethinks classifier reconstruction from a cross-layer perspective and generalizes ridge regression to jointly exploit cross-layer representations, thereby surpassing the performance of any individual layer. Specifically, after FL training, clients perform only a single forward pass to extract class-conditional statistics from predefined layers. The server aggregates these statistics to construct a joint cross-layer ridge classifier, where an adaptive coupling coefficient regulates cross-layer correlations, thereby facilitating the integration of complementary discriminative information. Extensive experiments across 11 datasets, 8 model architectures, and diverse data heterogeneity scenarios demonstrate that FLARE, as a plug-and-play post-processing method, improves accuracy by 11.35% with only one additional communication round.

papers.title_en: Client-Aware Security Adaptive Early Exit Vision Transformers for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.authors: Sahar Refaei Ghalibafan, Samira Nazari, Christian Herglotz, Maksim Jenihhin, Mahdi Taheri
papers.evidence: 异构联邦学习中的算力自适应推理机制
papers.tldr: 异构联邦学习中，各客户端的数据难度与算力预算不同，统一的视觉Transformer早退阈值难兼顾精度和计算。论文依据标签熵与浅层出口置信度构建客户端基础阈值，并结合预测熵、置信度、前二类间隔和出口深度进行逐样本调整。仅聚合实际更新参数的客户端贡献；在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-1K分别节省32.0%和30%推理深度，六客户端非独立同分布CIFAR-100精度达72.28%。该方法通过客户端感知的安全与鲁棒路由，提升异构环境下早退推理的效率和性能。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model across data-owning clients without centralizing raw data, but client data difficulty and compute budgets can differ. We study local early-exit Vision Transformer (ViT) inference, where an intermediate classifier may return a prediction before the final Transformer stage. The proposed method replaces one global acceptance threshold with a client-specific base threshold from label entropy and shallow-exit confidence, then adjusts each input using predictive entropy, confidence, top-two class margin, and exit depth. Aggregation uses only clients that updated a parameter. Security-aware routing reaches 88.70% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 32.0% depth saving and 73.7% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 30\% saving. On matched six-client non-IID CIFAR-100, full-depth accuracy is 72.28% versus 68.20--71.80% for four heterogeneous-FL baselines; robustness-aware routing reaches 70.01% with 32.55% saving.

papers.title_en: Toward a Universal Local Speech Feature Extractor Through Distillation
papers.authors: Jessica Yang, Marcelo Beramendi Caballero, Ju-Chieh Chou, Karen Livescu
papers.evidence: 蒸馏降低语音模型基础设施计算成本
papers.tldr: 自监督语音模型通常用卷积神经网络在前端提取局部特征，但这部分计算开销大，且不同模型的结构高度相似。论文提出以蒸馏训练仅两层的通用局部特征提取器，学习HuBERT、data2vec和WavLM等教师的表示。SUPERB及SUPERB-SG实验表明，它大体保持教师性能，并能迁移到未见过的wav2vec 2.0。该前端仅需原卷积层约3%的乘加运算，使整体推理时间降低超过20%，为复用轻量语音前端提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised speech models commonly consist of a set of convolutional neural network (CNN) layers used as a local feature extractor, followed by transformer layers. The CNN layers are computationally demanding, and are also similar across models and resemble the much simpler mel spectral features. We hypothesize that the CNN layers can be replaced by a simple, universal model. To test this hypothesis, we learn a two-layer feature extractor via distillation from one or more teacher models (HuBERT, data2vec, and WavLM). Experiments on SUPERB(-SG) benchmark tasks show that our model largely retains the performance of the teacher models and can also be used in an unseen model (wav2vec 2.0). Our feature extractor requires only 3% of the MACs of the CNNs, resulting in a $>$20% overall inference runtime reduction.

papers.title_en: Fluxion: A Differentiable DSP Runtime from Training GPU to Real-Time Edge
papers.evidence: 连接训练GPU与实时边缘部署的可微运行时
papers.tldr: 实时音频引擎虽能满足时限，却难接入机器学习训练；张量框架便于自动微分和GPU计算，但通常以离线批处理运行，缺少实时保证。Fluxion以统一图代数描述二阶节、FIR与延迟效果，并分别降级为可微训练引擎和零分配实时引擎。系统提供滤波器闭式设计、递归解析伴随、稳定性校验及版本化冻结工件。实验显示，在精确递归系统中其设备驻留GPU吞吐最高，并在多数CPU任务领先，为训练到边缘部署建立了可验证通路。
papers.abstract_en: Native real-time audio engines meet audio deadlines but are hard to connect to machine-learning workflows, while tensor frameworks integrate with machine learning but process audio as offline batches without timing guarantees; runtime layers built on them inherit the host's scheduling and deployment footprint. This paper presents Fluxion, a Rust audio DSP runtime for cascaded second-order sections, FIR filters, and delay-line effects. Fluxion implements the parts that are specific to DSP: closed-form filter design, forward kernels, analytic adjoints for the recursion, and stability checks. It relies on existing libraries for the autodiff graph, GPU code generation (tested here on CUDA), and array interchange. One graph algebra is lowered to a differentiable training engine and to an allocation-free real-time engine; between them, a trained graph is checked for stability and frozen into a versioned artifact that an edge device checks again before playback. We compare Fluxion with six framework-hosted and native baselines under one float32 protocol. Among the systems that compute the exact recursion, Fluxion has the highest GPU throughput when data stays on the device and the highest throughput on most CPU workloads, while its CPU training step is slower than those of torchaudio and GRAFX. Its test suite checks the audio thread for allocations with an instrumented allocator, and we report measured latency tails. Fluxion is open source at \url{https://github.com/matteospanio/fluxion}.

papers.title_en: Toward Collective Model Intelligence: Characterizing and Coordinating Models
papers.authors: SinapisAI Team, Jian-Dong Liu, Qun Dai, Zhendong Du, Guannan Lai, Hao-Yu Liu, Yi-Fan Ma, Zi-Yu Mao, Tengzhong Sun, Xin-Yi Zhang, Zi-Chen Zhao, Gelin Bian, Zongyuan Cai, Ju Cang, Zhangqin Chen, Shilei Gu, Guoding Ji, Taojian Jiang, Hao-Xuan Ma, Fan Wu, Lin-Xing Wu, Tao Yu, Xiao Zhang, Tianyi Zhou, Rong Gu, Ming Li, Zhi-Hao Tan, Han-Jia Ye, Yang Yu, De-Chuan Zhan
papers.evidence: 跨模型协作编排与资源约束下的高效执行
papers.tldr: 模型数量增长并不必然形成集体智能，关键瓶颈在于有限评测下刻画能力、按任务协调互补模型及受限资源下高效执行。论文提出由Model Eval、Mio和Mos组成的系统框架，分别负责能力估计、成本感知协作选择与服务调度。在九项基准上，Mio 1.0 Lite兼具最高平均得分和最低平均成本，较最佳高分替代方案单请求成本低73.7%至97.5%。该工作为异构模型资源的统一编排与集体模型智能奠定基础。
papers.abstract_en: Independently developed AI models accumulate diverse and complementary capabilities, but a growing model collection does not automatically realize Collective AI. Addressing this gap requires understanding model capabilities with limited evaluation, organizing complementary models to collaborate on diverse tasks, and executing model calls efficiently under resource constraints. We present a systematic approach to pursuing Collective Model Intelligence through three connected components. First, Model Eval constructs evidence-based capability profiles by combining query-level performance estimation with cross-domain prediction, reducing the need for exhaustive evaluation. Second, Mio (Models in One) organizes complementary model candidates and supports task-conditioned, cost-aware selection and collaboration as task requirements evolve. Third, Mos (Model Serving OS) separates model selection from execution and provides endpoint scheduling and shared model deployment and distribution. Experiments show lower capability-estimation errors under limited evaluation. Across nine public benchmarks, Mio 1.0 Lite achieves the highest average score and lowest average cost among compared methods, with per-request costs 73.7-97.5% lower than those of the best-scoring alternatives. A prewarmed shared cache accelerates model-file retrieval by up to 23.3 times. This work lays a foundation for Collective Model Intelligence by characterizing and coordinating the diverse capabilities of an expanding model universe.

papers.title_en: SARAM: Sparse Adapter Allocation with Reuse and Merging for Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.authors: SeongJun Jeong, Chungwoo Lee, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向GPU受限AI部署的适配器复用与资源优化
papers.tldr: 终身机器人学习需按序掌握新任务且避免遗忘，但传统适配器会随任务不断累积，带来存储、显存与部署开销压力。SARAM复用冻结适配器，仅在稀疏层新增模块，并以去重惩罚学习互补知识；部署时用激活统计签名识别任务，将更新合并至骨干网络。其在四套LIBERO基准上达到或超过适配器方法，每任务磁盘增量最多降低4.5倍，并在真实UR5序列任务中验证保持能力。该方案使任务流增长下的控制成本接近原始骨干，为资源受限机器人提供可扩展终身学习路径。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong robot learning requires acquiring new tasks sequentially without forgetting earlier ones. With large pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) backbones, adapter-based methods effectively mitigate this challenge. However, their task-specific adapters and selection modules accumulate with the task stream, creating a scalability challenge in on-disk storage and deployment cost under fixed onboard resource budgets. We propose SARAM, a lifelong learning framework that limits storage growth while keeping GPU memory and per-step inference cost independent of the task stream length. For each new task, SARAM reuses frozen adapters from previous tasks and introduces new adapters only at sparsely selected layers, with a duplication penalty encouraging them to capture information not already represented by the adapter library. At deployment, a compact signature derived from backbone activation statistics identifies the task once per episode, and the corresponding task update is merged into the backbone, leaving only the backbone in the control loop. Across four LIBERO suites, SARAM matches or exceeds adapter-based baselines while adding up to 4.5x less on-disk state per task. GPU memory usage and control frequency remain comparable to those of the backbone as the task stream grows. Experiments on a real UR5 arm with a different backbone further demonstrate retention throughout a sequential task stream.
